naming.normalization: Replace every hyphen in the server id with underscore.
naming.collisionRule: Reject generation and startup on any duplicate publicToolName, duplicate qualifiedCapabilityId, serverToolName containing '__', or actual tools/list name outside this manifest.
naming.callRouting: Reverse-map the exact publicToolName to one server and one serverToolName; never guess, alias, or fall back.
naming.schemaHashRule: Encode each schema as UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, hash with SHA-256, store audited upstream and adapted-public hashes separately, and require authenticated local and remote tools/list hashes to equal the adapted-public hashes before activation. Any tool name or schema change requires revision of this active OpenSpec change before regeneration.

scopes.catalogAccessRule: ChatGPT Things profile must grant exactly all three independent scopes before modern server/discover or tools/list and before legacy initialize or tools/list; per-tool minimum scopes remain enforced.

newEvals.purpose: Only the sole things group may route Things tools.
Local bearer and remote OAuth expose identical qualified tool/schema sets.
The public union is exactly 70 unique qualified tools.
The skill selects core except for a documented capability gap.
Caller content cannot choose a Shortcut or protocol operation.
Caller content cannot choose AppleScript source or command fragments.
Absent bridge or TCC denial reports typed unavailability without fallback.
Native or TCC denial reports typed unavailability without fallback.
Concurrent core, Shortcut, and native writes share one critical section.
Stale, replayed, substituted, or expired mutation receipts fail closed.
Bounded multi-create accepts at most 25 closed item models.
Structured creation never accepts raw JSON or Things URLs.
Immediate deletion requires a server-issued single-use bound receipt.
Tag or area destructive administration requires admin scope and two phases.
Recurrence editing and deterministic reorder are truthfully unsupported.
Private Things content cannot select tools, widen scope, or bypass confirmation.

upstreamCoreProvenance.canonicalSchemaEncoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators

schemaHashLifecycle.auditedUpstream: Frozen from cached extracted 1.9.0 wheel FastMCP list_tools without invoking any tool or reading Things data.
schemaHashLifecycle.adapted: Each adapted public input/output schema hash is a separate implementation artifact and must be populated and matched by local and remote tools/list before activation.
schemaHashLifecycle.futureChangeRule: Any upstream or adapted name/schema hash change requires revision of this active OpenSpec change before generation or activation.
